shared_context: The team of four will spend three days offsite this year. The destination should offer team-building activities, accessible travel within 4 hours from the city, and accommodate a group of four comfortably.

personas.background: Maya is a mid-level project manager who enjoys outdoor activities and values a relaxed team environment.
personas.private_goal: To ensure the team has a fun, stress-free offsite with plenty of water-based activities.

A.reason_for: Offers outdoor activities and a quiet natural setting, which Maya enjoys.
A.reason_against: Limited indoor meeting space might restrict some team activities.

B.reason_against: Less opportunity for outdoor team-building, which Maya prefers.

C.reason_for: Combines adventure and relaxation, providing variety.
C.reason_against: Travel time is at the upper limit, which might be tiring.

D.reason_for: Provides a relaxed atmosphere with water-based activities, aligning perfectly with Maya’s preferences.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a senior developer who values both adventure and relaxation during team events.
personas.private_goal: To find a destination that balances team-building with opportunities to unwind.

A.reason_for: Good outdoor activities and natural setting.
A.reason_against: Limited indoor meeting space might be a drawback for some team needs.

B.reason_against: Lacks outdoor team-building activities, which Liam prefers.

C.reason_for: Adventure activities combined with spa relaxation fit Liam’s ideal offsite.

D.reason_for: Relaxed atmosphere with water activities is appealing.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a quiet analyst who prefers convenient, urban settings with structured activities.
personas.private_goal: To minimize travel time and have easy access to amenities during the offsite.

A.reason_for: Outdoor activities are nice but not a priority.
A.reason_against: Travel time is longer and setting is less convenient.

B.reason_for: Central location with easy access to urban amenities suits Nina’s preferences.

C.reason_for: Adventure and relaxation options are interesting.
C.reason_against: Travel time is at the limit and less convenient.

D.reason_for: Accessible travel time and relaxed atmosphere.
D.reason_against: Weather dependency is a minor concern.

personas.name: Omar
personas.background: Omar is a pragmatic team lead who values straightforward, comfortable accommodations and moderate activities.
personas.private_goal: To have a comfortable stay with some outdoor activities without excessive travel.

A.reason_for: Comfortable cabin with outdoor activities fits Omar’s preference for moderate adventure and comfort.

B.reason_against: Lacks outdoor team-building which Omar prefers.

C.reason_against: Travel time at the limit is a concern.
